items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: the piano player, Johnnie Johnson, who again this Keith Richards, another guy who has studied this stuff, he says well he was the real leader of the band.

ctx.x: There’s a Chuck Berry record like that, that it’s almost like you can hear half the band doing one thing and the other half —

I think most of Chuck’s stuff — well I think that’s the prime example of it of course. Those Chuck Berry things, because that was rock & roll. Keith Richards likes to explain you know it had both elements. Today they’ve lost the roll. Everybody rocks in the straight eighth but Keith anyway refers to the swinging part of it and, you know, the bass player is swinging I would say in those, and the drummer is playing straight eighths and the piano player, Johnnie Johnson, who again this Keith Richards, another guy…
Doing that triplet thing. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
